common.outdatedError: Could not check for outdated tools

filter.noMatchBody: No rows match the current filter. Edit or clear it to bring the full list back.

directory.pickerFailed: The directory dialog could not be opened. Nothing was changed; try again.
directory.unavailableBody: {{path}} no longer exists or cannot be opened. Choose another directory to continue.

confirmSelfUpdate.title: Update mise?
confirmSelfUpdate.bodyWithLatest: This will run the exact command below. It upgrades mise from {{current}} to {{latest}} and replaces the installed binary.
confirmSelfUpdate.bodyUnknownLatest: This will run the exact command below. It upgrades mise from {{current}} to the latest release and replaces the installed binary.

banner.label: Untrusted config
banner.body: This directory's mise config file has not been trusted. Env vars and tasks stay disabled until you trust it.
banner.errorBody: MiseDeck could not determine this directory's trust state, so write actions are disabled.

trust.error: Could not trust the directory. Check the execution panel for details.

home.title: Home
home.hint: Is mise installed and new enough for MiseDeck? Guided install and self-update live here; every action streams through the execution panel.

tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: Tools installed and active for the current directory — add one with the search below; Use installs and records the request in one step.
tools.commandHint: mise outdated · mise ls · mise registry · mise upgrade · mise unuse · mise uninstall · mise use · mise ls-remote · mise install · mise link

orphan.tooltip: No config file requests this tool

tooltip.singleVersion: Only one version installed — find the tool in Manage versions below and install another version to switch.
tooltip.noVersion: No installed versions — find the tool in Manage versions below and install one.

empty.title: No tools installed
empty.body: Use the Manage versions search below to install your first tool.

missing.title: Tools unavailable
missing.body: MiseDeck needs the mise CLI to list installed tools. Go back and install mise, then return to this page.

error.title: Failed to load tools
error.body: mise ls --json did not return. Stderr is shown below.
error.bodyNoStderr: mise ls --json did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal.

addTool.title: Manage versions
addTool.noMatches: No matches — a full backend:name (e.g. npm:prettier) still works.
addTool.moreMatches: More matches — keep typing to narrow down.
addTool.notInstalledUninstallTooltip: This version is not installed — there is nothing to delete
addTool.globalAlsoActive: Also active through the global config: {{versions}}. Using a version here adds a request for the current directory; both stay active, and this directory's version wins here.
addTool.emptyInstalledBody: mise ls {{tool}} reports no installed versions of {{tool}} besides the active one.
addTool.emptyInstalledBodyNoActive: mise ls {{tool}} reports no installed versions of {{tool}}.

linkForm.title: Link a tool
linkForm.explanation: Link adopts a directory you built locally as an installed version instead of downloading one: mise link <tool>@<version> <path>, which symlinks it into mise.
linkForm.duplicateVersion: {{tool}}@{{version}} already exists. Uninstall it first, then link again.

use.title: Use {{tool}}@{{version}}?
use.bodyGlobal: Makes this version the active one and records it in the global mise config (config.toml); it is installed first if missing.
use.bodyDirectory: Makes this version the active one and records it in the nearest mise config (mise.toml); it is installed first if missing.

install.title: Install {{tool}}@{{version}}?
install.body: Installs this version; the config file stays unchanged.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{tool}}@{{version}}?
uninstall.body: Deletes this version's installation files; the config file stays unchanged. If it is the active version, it is reinstalled automatically the next time.
uninstall.bodyActive: This version is currently active. Uninstalling deletes its installation files; the config file keeps requesting it, so commands that need it fail until it is reinstalled.

unuse.title: Unuse {{tool}}?
unuse.body: The tool is no longer used: it is removed from the config file, and installation files no other config uses are deleted as well.

upgrade.title: Upgrade {{tool}}?
upgrade.body: Upgrades to the newest version within the range written in the config file, and installs it.

guard.untrustedBody: Trust this directory before mutating its tools.

tools.hintGlobal: Tools installed and active in Global mode — add one with the search below; Use installs and records the request in one step.

preview.hint: Resolved tools, env, config files, and lockfile for the current directory.
preview.hintGlobal: Resolved env and config files for Global mode.
preview.commandHint: mise trust · mise -C <dir> ls · mise env · mise config

empty.body: The env and config sections already show the global resolution; this list is per-directory. Choose a directory to see what mise -C <dir> ls reports there.

config.orderNote: In precedence order, highest first — the same order mise config ls --json reports.
config.emptyGlobal: mise config ls found no global config files.
config.emptyDirectory: mise config ls found no config files for the current directory.
config.errorBody: mise config ls --json did not return. Stderr is shown below.
config.errorBodyNoStderr: mise config ls --json did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again.

env.emptyBody: mise env --json returned an empty map. Add an [env] table to a mise config file to surface values here.
env.errorBody: mise env --json did not return. Stderr is shown below.
env.errorBodyNoStderr: mise env --json did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again.

toolsError.title: Failed to load resolved tools
toolsError.body: mise -C <dir> ls --json did not return. Stderr is shown below.
toolsError.bodyNoStderr: mise -C <dir> ls --json did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again.

lockfile.title: mise.lock
lockfile.errorBody: MiseDeck could not read the current directory's mise.lock. The error message is shown below.

env.title: Env
env.hint: Resolved environment variables for the current directory. Add, edit, or remove vars; every write goes through mise set / mise unset and streams into the panel.
env.commandHint: mise env · mise set · mise unset

empty.title: No env vars
empty.bodyGlobal: Use the form below to add your first env var; writes go to mise's global config.
empty.bodyDirectory: Use the form below to add your first env var; writes go to mise's config file for the current directory.

error.title: Failed to load env vars
error.body: mise env did not return. Stderr is shown below.
error.bodyNoStderr: mise env did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal.

guard.untrustedBody: Trust this directory before mutating its env vars.

tooltip.tool: Injected by {{tool}} via mise env; resolved at runtime, not settable via mise set.
tooltip.default: Inherited from the host environment; not written by mise, so not settable via mise set.
tooltip.configTool: Requested by the config file and injected by {{tool}}; overridable via mise set.
tooltip.unsetOutOfScope: Defined in {{source}}, outside the active directory's config — Unset would not take effect.

unset.title: Unset {{name}}?
unset.bodyGlobal: This will run the exact command below. The env var will be removed from the global mise config and this cannot be undone.
unset.bodyDirectory: This will run the exact command below. The env var will be removed from the current directory's mise config and this cannot be undone.

overwrite.title: Overwrite {{name}}?
overwrite.body: An env var named {{name}} already exists; adding it again overwrites the current value. This will run the exact command below.

rename.title: Rename {{from}} to {{to}}?
rename.body: Renaming runs the two exact commands below in order: first the new key is written, then the old key is removed. The removal runs only when the write succeeds, so a failure cannot destroy the old value. This cannot be undone.

renameOverwrite.title: Rename {{from}} to {{to}}?
renameOverwrite.body: An env var named {{to}} already exists — the rename overwrites its current value with the value of {{from}}. Renaming runs the two exact commands below in order: first the new key is written, then the old key is removed. The removal runs only when the write succeeds. This cannot be undone.

update.title: Update {{name}}?
update.body: This will run the exact command below.

confirm.outOfScopeWarningGlobal: Defined in {{source}}, outside the global mise config — the command writes to the global config and leaves this variable's actual definition unchanged.
confirm.outOfScopeWarningDirectory: Defined in {{source}}, outside the current directory's mise config — the command writes to the current directory's config and leaves this variable's actual definition unchanged.

success.unsetDirectory: {{name}} removed from the current directory's config

env.hintGlobal: Resolved environment variables for Global mode. Add, edit, or remove vars; every write goes through mise set -g / mise unset -g and streams into the panel.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: List, run, create, and edit the mise tasks for the current directory. Writes go through mise tasks add and stream into the panel.
tasks.commandHint: mise tasks ls · mise run · mise tasks add · mise tasks edit · mise config ls

empty.title: No tasks
empty.body: mise tasks ls returned no tasks here. Tasks come from the [tasks] table of a mise.toml, or from executable files under mise-tasks/.

editBlocked.scope: Inline edit is unavailable: this task is defined in another config or comes from a file task. Use Open in editor.
editBlocked.lossy: Inline edit is unavailable: this task has fields the form cannot rewrite (aliases, dir, shell, sources, outputs, hide, …). Use Open in editor.

editForm.title: Edit task
editForm.dependsHelpGlobal: Each name is a task in the global mise config. Separate with commas.
editForm.dependsHelpDirectory: Each name is a task in the current directory's config file. Separate with commas.
editForm.runReadonlyTooltip: This task's run has multiple lines. The GUI saves tasks through mise tasks add, which stores run as a single line — editing it here would change what the task does. Edit the run in the config file instead (Open in editor).

flattenRun.title: Rewrite the multi-line run?
flattenRun.body: This task's run has multiple lines. Saving writes it back as the single line below, which changes what the task does. To keep the run as multiple lines, cancel and edit the config file instead (Open in editor).

run.title: Run {{name}}?
run.body: Runs the task through mise run. Arguments are split into words and passed after -- verbatim — mise receives the argv directly, with no shell in between.

guard.untrustedBody: Trust this directory before mutating its tasks.

openEditorError.title: Could not open the config file
openEditorError.body: mise tasks edit did not return a usable path. If the command failed, its stderr is in the execution panel.

openConfigError.body: mise config ls --json did not return a config file to open. If the command failed, its stderr is in the execution panel.

readError.title: Failed to load tasks
readError.body: mise tasks ls --json did not return. Stderr is shown below.
readError.bodyNoStderr: mise tasks ls --json did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal.

tasks.subtitleGlobal: List, run, create, and edit the mise tasks for Global mode. Writes go through mise tasks add and stream into the panel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: View and edit mise settings for the current directory. Writes go through mise settings set / mise settings unset and stream into the panel.
settings.commandHint: mise settings ls · mise settings set · mise settings unset

empty.title: No settings configured
empty.body: Add a setting to write it into mise's config.
empty.bodyShowAll: mise's defaults still apply — this list shows only what is explicitly set here.

error.title: Failed to load settings
error.body: mise settings ls did not return. Stderr is shown below.
error.bodyNoStderr: mise settings ls did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal.

settings.showAllScope: Show all lists mise's full settings set — built-in defaults and global config included. Writes still target this directory's config.

guard.untrustedBody: Trust this directory before mutating its settings.

success.unsetDirectory: {{key}} removed from the current directory's config

overwrite.title: Overwrite {{key}}?
overwrite.body: The setting {{key}} already has a value; adding it again overwrites the current value. This will run the exact command below.

unset.title: Unset {{key}}?
unset.bodyGlobal: This will run the exact command below. The setting {{key}} will be removed from the global mise config and this cannot be undone.
unset.bodyDirectory: This will run the exact command below. The setting {{key}} will be removed from the current directory's mise config and this cannot be undone.

tooltip.objectReadOnly: Table-typed settings cannot be written by mise settings set — edit the config file directly.
tooltip.unsetOutOfScope: Defined in {{source}}, outside the current directory's config — Unset would not take effect.
tooltip.unsetDefault: This key only carries a built-in default — there is nothing to unset.

settings.hintGlobal: View and edit mise's global settings. Writes go through mise settings set / mise settings unset and stream into the panel.

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.hint: A health check for mise — the global setup or the chosen directory. When the structured report is unavailable, the raw doctor output renders with warnings highlighted.

missing.title: Doctor unavailable
missing.body: MiseDeck needs the mise CLI to run the health check. Go back and install mise, then return to this page.

toolset.title: Resolved toolset
toolset.emptyBodyGlobal: mise doctor --json reported an empty global toolset.
toolset.emptyBodyDirectory: mise doctor --json reported an empty toolset for the current directory.

error.title: Failed to load doctor
error.body: mise doctor --json did not return. Stderr is shown below.
error.bodyNoStderr: mise doctor --json did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal.

updateNotice.title: Update available
updateNotice.framing: A new mise release is available.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Installed plugins — the asdf-style or vfox-style plugins that teach mise how to install tools.
plugins.commandHint: mise plugins install · mise plugins ls · mise plugins uninstall

installForm.title: Install plugin
installForm.explanation: Add a custom plugin the way the CLI does: a name plus the plugin's git URL — the asdf-ecosystem standard for tools with no built-in shorthand.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.body: This will run the exact command below. The plugin will be removed and this cannot be undone. Tools installed through this plugin keep their files on disk.

installedEmpty.title: No plugins installed
installedEmpty.body: Most tools install with no plugin at all — search the Tools page to install one. To add a custom plugin, use the form above: a name plus its git URL.

installedError.title: Failed to load plugins
installedError.body: mise plugins ls did not return. Stderr is shown below.
installedError.bodyNoStderr: mise plugins ls did not return and wrote no stderr. Refresh to try again; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal.

notInstalled.title: mise not found
notInstalled.body: MiseDeck could not locate the mise binary on this machine. Guided install below runs the official install script through the execution panel; the install guide lists the manual steps.

tooOld.title: mise is too old
tooOld.body: Found {{found}}, but MiseDeck requires at least {{minimum}}. Update mise by running mise self-update.
tooOld.packageManagerHint: If mise came from a package manager (Homebrew, apt, …), update it with that manager — mise self-update cannot replace a package-managed binary. Otherwise reinstall with the guided installer or follow the install guide.

commandFailed.title: mise failed
commandFailed.body: mise version --json exited with a non-zero status. Stderr is shown below.
commandFailed.bodyNoStderr: mise version --json exited with a non-zero status but wrote no stderr. Retry the probe; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal.

probeFailed.title: Could not check mise
probeFailed.body: The mise version probe did not complete. The error is shown below; retry the probe.

parseFailed.title: Unrecognized mise response
parseFailed.body: MiseDeck could not parse the output of mise version --json. You may be running a forked build.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.label: Render failed
errorBoundary.body: This page stopped while rendering. Nothing was written to your mise configuration — go back to Home and try again.

errors.miseNotFound: The mise CLI was not found on this machine. Install it from https://mise.jdx.dev/installing.html and relaunch MiseDeck.
errors.miseTooOld: Found mise {{found}}, but MiseDeck requires at least {{minimum}}. Update mise by running mise self-update.
errors.terminalNotFound: No terminal emulator was found on this Linux system.
errors.timeout: mise did not respond within the timeout. Try the action again; if it keeps happening, run the command in a terminal to see more.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. The execution panel has the details.

theme.chromeFailedBody: The page theme changed, but the native title bar could not follow. The page and the window chrome may look different until the app restarts.

execution.title: Execution
execution.copyHint: Copy the exact command to your clipboard
execution.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the command — it is still running. Try again.
execution.emptyHint: No command has been run yet.
execution.outputTruncated: {{stream}} output was truncated; the command kept running.

failureNotice.label: Action failed
failureNotice.body: MiseDeck could not complete the action.

activation.openInTerminalError: Could not open a terminal at {{path}}. Copy the command and run it yourself.
activation.bannerBody: Your {{shell}} config at {{rcPath}} does not have the mise activate line. Add the line below to the end of that file (create it if it does not exist), save it, then reopen your terminal — it is a profile entry, not a command to run.
activation.bannerBodyUnknownShell: MiseDeck does not know how to activate {{name}}. Add the appropriate mise activate line to its rc file to use mise in interactive sessions.
activation.bannerBodyUnverified: MiseDeck could not determine whether mise is activated for this shell. Compare the line below with your rc file, and add it if it is missing.
activation.errorBody: MiseDeck could not determine whether mise is activated in your shell. Retry the check.
